description: Go log/slog handlers that write Google Cloud Logging entries, with trace linking, OpenTelemetry baggage, Kubernetes pod labels, and Error Reporting fields.
rules: Import m4o.io/gslog/stdout or m4o.io/gslog/gcp. The root m4o.io/gslog package is deprecated.
Use the stdout handler when a logging agent reads stdout: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, GKE, and GCE with the Ops Agent.
Use the gcp handler when no logging agent reads stdout. It sends entries with the cloud.google.com/go/logging client.
All options from the core, otel, otel/detect, k8s, and errorreporting packages work with both handlers.
Log with a context, such as logger.InfoContext(ctx, ...), to get the trace fields. The handler reads the span only from the context of the log call.
Close the logging.Client before the program exits. This flushes the entries that the gcp handler buffers.
